info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Underwriting Details Retrieval API
info.description: The Underwriting Details Retrieval API enables users to access specific underwriting information associated with a given underwriting ID. This API is designed for financial institutions and insurance companies to retrieve and review underwriting records efficiently. Typical consumers include underwriters, analysts, and customer service representatives who need quick access to detailed underwriting data for decision-making or customer inquiries. By providing comprehensive insights into underwriting metrics, this API supports enhanced risk assessment and operational transparency.

get.summary: Retrieve underwriting details for a specific sale.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed underwriting information related to the sale with ID RES-100045. It provides essential insights and data necessary for further processing and decision-making.
